meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 就有 Microsoft Teams 通道：直接在 Teams 频道、群聊或私聊里对话。流程自动复制并注册 Teams 适配器，用 CLI 创建机器人、存凭据，并引导安装。可重复运行。
howto.when: 当你想让助手接入 Microsoft Teams，例如要求“加上 Teams 频道”或“让机器人能在 Teams 里聊天”时，这个技能就会开始运行设置流程。

say.text: 帮我把助手接入 Microsoft Teams
say.note: 开始执行 add-teams 技能，复制并注册适配器。

say.text: 我想在 Teams 里和我的助手聊天
say.note: 检查已有凭据，没有就创建机器人并引导安装。

say.text: 重新配置一下 Teams 集成
say.note: 可安全重跑，已有凭据会跳过创建步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gets a Microsoft Teams channel: you can talk to it in team channels, group chats, or DMs. The workflow automatically copies and registers the Teams adapter, creates a bot via the CLI, stores credentials, and guides you through installing the app. It is safe to re-run.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Microsoft Teams support, e.g. 'add Teams channel' or 'let the bot chat in Teams'. The skill then runs the setup flow.

say_en.text: Help me connect my assistant to Microsoft Teams
say_en.note: Starts add-teams; copies and registers the adapter.

say_en.text: I want to chat with my assistant inside Teams
say_en.note: If no creds, creates bot and guides install.
Safe to re-run; existing credentials skip creation steps.
